description: Search the Utah Code BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "concealed weapon permit", "landlord retaliatory eviction", "DUI penalties". Returns ranked sections with their citations; use ut_code_section afterward for the full text of one. Full-text search, so it answers questions no citation lookup can. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results, default and maximum 10 — le.utah.gov's Solr proxy ignores the row count and always returns 10, so a larger value cannot be honoured.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "concealed weapon permit".

name: ut_code_search
title: Ut Code Search
